title: Execution Hash Explorer
description: Teaching explorer for the OpenChainGraph execution_hash. Paste or load any OCG artifact JSON and the page extracts {policy_parameters, output_payload}, canonicalizes them with the estate's byte-identical inline JCS serializer, recomputes the SHA-256 execution_hash with WebCrypto, and compares it to the embedded value. Three views make the mechanism visible: a raw-to-canonical side-by-side of what JCS did to the bytes, the preimage boundary showing exactly which members are hashed and which are excluded, and a parent_hashes chain walk rendered as a small graph. Verdicts: MATCH, MISMATCH, MALFORMED, NOT_AN_OCG_ARTIFACT. A #selftest=1 fragment runs the bundled golden fixture (MATCH) and its one-byte tampered twin (MISMATCH) end to end. Teaching surface for the hash alone: it never verifies signatures or Merkle inclusion; the OCG Receipt Verifier owns that. Runs entirely in the browser, zero network, zero storage, deterministic.
